text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I updated the KPI dashboard for Friday. Added a small annotation about a 5-8% attribution gap we found for the webinar cohort.

Maya: dashboard: https://app.redwood-internal/dash/quick-kpi (preview)

Jae: saw the note. Can you paste the cohort SQL so I can sanity-check sessions joins?

Maya: snippet:
```
SELECT lead_id, utm_source, created_at FROM marketing_leads WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-17' AND tag='webinar_apr'
```

Riley: flagged the missing utm_campaign earlier — we had ~6% blank on mobile submits. If GTM, quick patch; if server-side, need a mapping rule.

Sam: I'll run the GA4 vs backend crosswalk and post diffs by 4pm. If server-side mapping is the issue I'll add a fallback 'utm_missing' field.

Lina: Sales reported a couple leads routed to the wrong SDR queue because region was empty. Please add fallback region='unassigned' on ingest so routing doesn't drop.

Sam: plan: add fallback + test on staging, rolling patch if green. ETA EOD.

Maya: action items — Sam: crosswalk + patch; Riley: add per-channel micro-sparks to top row; Jae: run session join after Sam posts diffs; Lina: confirm routing after fix.
